description: This file defines the Java interface 'RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand' within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.query' package. It specifies a live command for retrieving attribute data, extending base command interfaces, and includes a method to get a JSON pointer for the attribute.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command to retrieve a specific attribute, providing access to the attribute via a JSON pointer, and supporting command chaining and query functionalities.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute to be retrieved.
